content:
Returns details for a user-defined template. User-defined templates can be used to define scan
configurations.
Requires either the Scan Operator [24] user role, the WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE  custom role privilege,
or the WAS.SCAN_WAS_USER_TEMPLATE.READ  custom role privilege. Additionally, requires the Can
View [16] scan template (policy) permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the user-defined template.
user_template_id
required
